android.desc:
PDFDesk is an all-in-one PDF editor, PDF converter and document scanner for Android. Scan paper documents with your camera, convert files to and from PDF, merge and split PDF files, shrink large documents, and lock a PDF with a password — all handled directly on your phone.

📄 CONVERT
• PDF to Image — save any PDF page as a JPG or PNG
• Image to PDF — turn photos and screenshots into one PDF
• Word to PDF — convert DOC and DOCX files to PDF

📂 MANAGE
• Merge PDF — combine several PDF files into a single document
• Split PDF — separate one PDF into multiple files
• Remove Pages — delete unwanted pages from a PDF
• Compress PDF — reduce PDF file size for email and WhatsApp

🔒 PROTECT
• Lock PDF — password protect any PDF file
• Unlock PDF — remove the password from a PDF you own
• Watermark — stamp text across every page

📷 SCAN TO PDF
Use the camera as a pocket document scanner. Capture receipts, handwritten notes, ID cards, bills and multi-page reports straight into a clean PDF.

🗂 MY FILES
Everything you create stays in one place. Open, rename, share or delete any file without leaving the app.

📝 Extract Text (OCR)
Extract text from any PDF instantly. Copy text to clipboard or save as .txt file. Perfect for pulling content from reports, invoices, and documents.

📄 PDF → Word (.docx)
Convert PDF files to editable Word documents. Preserve text and page structure. Edit your PDFs in any word processor — Microsoft Word, Google Docs, and more.

📊 PDF → Excel (.xlsx)
Convert PDF tables and data into Excel spreadsheets. Smart column detection automatically organizes your data into rows and columns. Open in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or any spreadsheet app.

⚡ WHY SMART PDF
• Processed on your device — your documents are never uploaded to a server
• No sign-up, no account, no login
• Choose where your files are saved
• Pick output quality: low, medium or high
• Optional auto-delete for older files
• Dark mode
• Available in English, हिन्दी, ગુજરાતી, मराठी and தமிழ்
• Simple, one-handed interface — every tool is two taps from the home screen

🎓 MADE FOR EVERYDAY WORK
Students merging lecture notes, shopkeepers compressing invoices for WhatsApp, office staff converting reports, anyone who needs a scanned copy of a document in the next thirty seconds. No desktop, no website, no upload queue.

ℹ️ ABOUT ADS
Smart PDF is supported by ads so every tool stays available to everyone at no cost. The ads library needs an int

quotes.text:
Hey everyone

I'm a Flutter developer from India, and I got frustrated with PDF apps that either charge monthly subscriptions or are loaded with ads for basic features.

So I built PDFDesk — a completely free PDF tool that handles everything:

• Edit PDF text, add signatures & annotations
• Scan documents using your phone camera
• Merge multiple PDFs into one
• Split PDFs into separate files
• Convert PDF to Word, Excel, and Images (and vice versa)
• Compress PDFs to reduce file size
• Password protect / unlock PDFs
• Add watermarks
• Reorder, rotate & delete pages

It's lightweight, fast, and works completely offline for most features.

I'd really appreciate it if you could check it out and share any feedback!

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.app.smart_pdf

Happy to answer any questions about the app or the tech behind it (Flutter + Dart).

Thanks!
